title: Bounty Syndicate
description:
Bounty Syndicate is a PvP-focused plugin by liq6 that adds a fully interactive bounty system to your server. Players can place bounties on others using in-game money and hunt targets for rewards.

It features a sleek GUI bounty board (/bounty)
body:
🔥 Bounty Syndicate

Author: liq6
Turn your server into a high-stakes PvP battlefield with a fully interactive bounty system.

💰 What is Bounty Syndicate?
Bounty Syndicate adds a dynamic bounty system where players can place rewards on others and hunt them down for profit. Perfect for survival, SMP, and PvP servers inspired by chaotic gameplay styles.

⚔️ Features
🧾 Bounty Board GUI
Use /bounty to open a clean, interactive GUI
View all active bounties as player heads

💀 Player Bounties
Place bounties using:
/bounty set <player> <amount>
Money is taken directly from your balance

💸 Vault Integration
Fully hooked into Vault
Supports economy plugins like EssentialsX
Kill a player with a bounty → instantly receive the reward

📄 Pagination System
Handles large numbers of bounties
Easy navigation with next/previous buttons

🚫 Clean UI Controls
Centered close button
Simple and intuitive design

🧠 Perfect For
SMP servers
PvP-focused servers
Economy-based gameplay
Content creator servers (adds drama and rivalries)

📦 Requirements
Paper / Spigot server, 
Vault plugin, 
Economy plugin (e.g. EssentialsX Economy)

🚀 Commands
/bounty             → Open bounty GUI
/bounty set        → Place a bounty
/bounty remove     → Remove a bounty
/bounty reload     → Reload config (If you made changes to plugin.yml manually)

⚠️ Notes
Players must have enough money to place a bounty (Powered by Vault)
Rewards are automatically paid on kill
Designed for performance and simplicity
